human_in_loop_decisions: All decisions that directly affect employment access — including shortlist recommendations — require a mandatory named recruiter reviewer with time authority and override rights before any rejection is finalized
strongest_guardrails: Zero automated adverse-action execution combined with continuous demographic adverse-impact ratio monitoring (four-fifths rule) across all reporting periods
cross_industry_pattern: High-stakes AI systems that influence access to employment or economic opportunity must be restricted to recommendation-only automation with hard guardrails against automated rejection regardless of scale; this pattern is consistent with EU AI Act Annex III High-Risk classification and EEOC adverse impact guidance and is expected to apply across any sector where AI influences access to rights or livelihood
